BindingRole.title: BindingRole
BindingRole.description: The roles a Model Binding can have (glossary value set).

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: The action a Product's answer commits to (glossary: Decision).

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description:
Every error code a client can receive. Values are part of the API: never rename one.

A new, more specific code is added here and passed at the raise site, for
example `NotFoundError(code=ErrorCode.USER_NOT_FOUND)`.

FailureType.title: FailureType
FailureType.description: What kind of mistake a Golden catches; each has its Metric (PP-203).

FailureTypeCountsResponse.title: FailureTypeCountsResponse
FailureTypeCountsResponse.description: How many Goldens of the current version have each failure type; zeros included.

GoldenOwner.title: GoldenOwner
GoldenOwner.description: The team that owns a Golden's fix (PP-205): a team, never a person.

ManifestReplace.title: ManifestReplace
ManifestReplace.description: A replacement: the version being replaced and the new eval.yaml text.

PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange
PasswordChange.description:
A new password for the current user, confirmed with the current one.

The policy check needs the account's username and email, so it runs in the
service, not here.

Permission.title: Permission
Permission.description: A named capability that an endpoint can require.

RoleDetails.title: RoleDetails
RoleDetails.description: A role and the permissions it currently grants.

RoleName.title: RoleName
RoleName.description: The built-in roles. Used for seeding and role assignment, never for access checks.

UserAdminUpdate.title: UserAdminUpdate
UserAdminUpdate.description:
Changes an administrator may make to any account.

Nobody may change their own role or active status; the service enforces that.

UserCreate.title: UserCreate

the service, not here.

UserDetails.description: An account as administrators see it.
